small_guidance: Reduce register pressure in conv_transpose3d_scatter_kernel (currently 207 regs/thread, limiting occupancy to 16%): hoist the kd/kh/kw loops inside the IC loop or vice-versa so the accumulator doesn't balloon, and shrink BLOCK_OC to 16 with BLOCK_SP=128 to get more warps/SM. Also add num_stages=1 and num_warps=8, and skip kernel iterations where od/oh/ow are entirely out-of-range to cut wasted atomics.
large_guidance: Redesign as a gather-based conv_transpose (one program per output tile (N, OC_tile, OD*OH*OW tile)) rather than scatter-add: for each output voxel (od,oh,ow), enumerate the (ic, kd, kh, kw) contributions where (od+PD-kd) is divisible by SD and the resulting id is in range, then accumulate via tl.dot over IC as a GEMM. This eliminates atomic_add traffic (currently ~200MB writes) and the separate init_bias_kernel (fold bias into epilogue), and lets you also fuse the BN scale/shift + spatial-mean subtract into the same kernel epilogue with a two-pass reduction per (N, OC).
